## Fatal finding

- **Item:** `thm-minimal-polynomial-is-well-defined-and-controls-annihilators`  
  **Location:** `[L3]` and proof step 1.2, [lines 42–52](</Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-minimal-polynomial-is-well-defined-and-controls-annihilators.md:42>)

  **Defect:** Inaccurate, load-bearing citation with a changed domain. `[L3]` claims that the cited lemma establishes monicity and degree for the characteristic polynomial of an endomorphism. The cited lemma actually states only:

  > “For \(A\in M_n(F)\), the polynomial \(\chi_A(x)\) is monic of degree \(n\)… For \(n=0\), \(\chi_A(x)=1\).”

  See [the dependency’s Statement](</Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-characteristic-polynomial-is-monic-and-has-extreme-coefficients.md:30>). Step 1.2 then explicitly relies on the inflated operator-form restatement to conclude that \(\chi_T\neq0\). The necessary bridge \(\chi_T=\chi_{[T]_{\mathcal B}^{\mathcal B}}\) is stated in [def-characteristic-polynomial-of-an-operator](</Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/def-characteristic-polynomial-of-an-operator.md:31>), but that item is neither declared nor cited here.

  **Severity:** **fatal** (`dependency_citation`). The theorem is true, but its load-bearing Fact attributes an endomorphism claim to a matrix-only dependency.

No other fatal defect was found.
